code-appearance.text:
What the code needs for these boards:
- Order Theme (macOS: Auto, Light, Dark; Android: System default, Light, Dark), then Tone, then Accent. Today both apps show Mode (System, Light, Dark), Accent color, Background tone (AppearanceSection.kt:82-91, AppearanceControls.swift:15-59). bae change.
- “Tone” and “Accent” in every locale. Today “Accent color” and “Background tone” (strings.xml:235-236, AppearanceControls.swift:21, :59). bae change.

code-library.text:

- macOS: Library folder with Show in Finder replaces the Path row (LibrarySettingsTab.swift:45). bae change.

setup-code-gaps.text:
What the code needs for these boards:
- Restore code at the end of setup: the bridge already returns it (BridgeStorageSetup.restore_code), but the macOS sheet drops it (SyncSetupWizard.swift connected). bae change.
- Done lands on the Sync page with Restore code on it: bae change. The code can be fetched again any time (generate_restore_code).
- Cancel while setup runs: coven can't stop a setup once it starts. Journaling setup (coven list) makes this Cancel real, and lets a crash resume or undo. coven change, then bae.
- Not synced page, Sync page and their states: bae change, over coven's sync state, as the Sync row's boards and their note show.
- Choose then Continue, and the browser opening on Continue: today each provider is a row that opens its form, and Dropbox and OneDrive wait for Sign in…. bae change.
- S3 row reads “A bucket you manage.” Today the app says “Any S3-compatible storage (AWS, Backblaze, Cloudflare R2, …)” (BridgeCloudProvider+Setup.swift:13), naming Backblaze, which setup refuses (coven notes/providers.md). bae change.
- Choose an empty folder: after Set up, setup checks the folder first (Checking the folder…) and, if it holds anything, stops and returns to the list saying so. Setup refuses a Dropbox or OneDrive folder that already holds files, as it refuses an occupied S3 bucket. Today only S3 is checked (coven bucket_claim.rs:17-26). coven change.
- New folder… on Dropbox (makes the folder and shares it): coven can't make and share a Dropbox folder; it calls sharing/share_folder only in its live tests (dropbox_live.rs:122). coven change, then bae.
- One folder picker for Dropbox and OneDrive, the same view on each platform: the list, the empty-folder line, New folder… and its naming row, checking, not empty. Only the provider's facts differ: OneDrive folders open into others (where you are, ›), Dropbox's shared folders are one flat list and a new one is shared. Today macOS keeps one state for both (StorageFolderBrowser.swift) but draws two different lists (OAuthFolderSetup.swift:78-119), and Android has OneDriveBrowser.kt beside ProviderFolderChoice.kt. bae change.
- S3 form: Endpoint, Region, Bucket, the key, in the Sync page's order; no service menu. Under Endpoint a line names what coven recognizes from the host (Cloudflare R2, Google Cloud Storage; coven config.rs:52-57), or says bae will detect the settings during setup, which it does for every other endpoint. There is no Advanced: a library takes the whole bucket, and Profile and Detect settings go. Today the form is Bucket, Region, Endpoint, keys, with Profile and Detect settings in Advanced (S3SetupForm.swift:42-97). bae change; coven needs a call that names the service an endpoint matches.
- Everything else, the steps and their words, the folder pickers, the S3 fields and the failure line, is what the code does today.
- macOS: every sheet ends in a MacSheetFooter, the one primary button on the right. The code has no shared sheet footer yet. bae change.

setup-rules.text:
Set up sync:
macOS only, from Set up sync… on a library that isn't synced. The baeium edition offers S3 only, so it opens on the S3 form. Each step that waits says so: signing in in the browser, listing folders, then setup's own steps over a bar. When storage refuses, bae says why and offers Try again. Every screen has Cancel and no Back: Cancel takes you back one screen, and on Choose it closes the sheet. The sheet ends on the restore code, for every provider: bae can’t tell whether iCloud Keychain carries it off this Mac. Done lands on the Sync page, which reads Syncing… while the library uploads, then Synced, and holds the Restore code section.

Each provider's row below shows every step coven reports, in order, with the words bae shows. No step has a count, so the bar moves without filling. S3 runs Detecting the service's settings… again even after Detect settings.

storage-proposed.text: Proposed: the panel is this release only: its upload summary with Cancel, then one line per file. A dashed circle marks a queued file, a filling ring an uploading one; stored files show nothing. Pause for the whole sync queue moves to the window's footer.

storage-today.text: Today: Pause floats mid-header (a hidden Cancel All still holds its space). Bytes read Zero kB of Zero kB while 3 upload. A file with no audio format keeps an empty second line. A status chip adds a third line plus an invisible bar's height, so rows jump between three heights.

switch-rules.text: macOS keeps switching libraries from the main window's menu.

sync-rules.text:
How the sync states behave:
- coven gives the state; bae picks the words and the fix.
- When several hold, the first shows: Not synced, Removed from the library, Device needs reset, Update needed, Signed out, No access, Folder missing, Clock is wrong, Storage full, Offline · unsent changes, Offline, Sync failed, Syncing…, Waiting to sync, Synced.
- Not synced is macOS only: a phone joins a library and never makes one.
- Syncing… only while something is sent or received, not on quiet passes.
- Waiting to sync: online, with changes held back. Gray when uploads are paused or an upload waits to retry; amber when the provider asked bae to wait, saying when it resumes. Android never uploads files, so its only reason is the provider's wait.
- Synced means data and files both: a file still uploading is Syncing….
- Offline with changes waiting is Offline · unsent changes, with no count.
- Signed out names the provider and its sign-in: Dropbox and OneDrive sign in from bae; iCloud from System Settings. S3 has no sign-in: it reads Access key not accepted and asks for a new key for the same bucket. An expired sign-in reads the same as none saved.
- Sync failed: any failure with no state of its own, its cause in plain words, always with Retry now; it also retries by itself. A file that can't be uploaded (missing, or changed since import) names the file until it's back as it was; nothing skips it. Phones never upload, so their causes are local ones, a provider error or a damaged change.
- The Library page's Sync row and the top of the Sync page show the same block: the state, Last synced under a problem state (never under Synced), the cause and the fix. The Sync page adds the storage details under it.
- Settings' Library row (Android) and the settings sidebar's Library item (macOS) show the state only when it's amber or red.
- No Sync stopped, no Checking sync… and no Disconnect anywhere.
- No raw ids on the Sync page: a row shows a name or isn't there.

transfers-rules.text:
Transfers:
no upload or download speed limits on any platform (CloudKit can't be paced). Android has no Pause uploads: a phone never uploads files. On macOS, while uploads are paused the sidebar shows an amber Paused beside Transfers.

welcome-rules.text:
Removing and deleting:
neither asks for device authentication. A library that was never synced offers Delete instead of Remove, on Android and macOS.

work-folder-name.text:
Folder (OneDrive, Dropbox):
coven records the picked folder's name and web address at setup, as labels only, never to reach storage. The Sync page shows Folder and Open in browser for those two; S3 and iCloud get neither.

work-history-off.text:
Listening history:
Off records no new plays; plays recorded before stay as they were. Everyone shares your plays with the library's people.

work-wifi-only.text:
Download over Wi-Fi only (Android), off by default:
while on, coven holds downloads and uploads on a metered network. coven watches the network itself. Playing a track that isn't pinned still streams.
